name: Xinference Community Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted model-serving software for language, speech and multimodal models; no software-enforced monthly request quota; OpenAI-compatible API, CLI and web UI.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires your own CPU/GPU, RAM, storage and operations; some model weights, runtimes or integrations have separate licenses and costs. Enterprise features and support are separate.
